description: This file defines a Kivy module for an interactive widget inspector, allowing users to select, highlight, and view properties of widgets within a Kivy application. It includes classes for the inspector UI, widget tree management, and functions to create, start, and stop the inspector.

classes.name: TreeViewProperty
classes.description: A property node for displaying widget properties in the inspector tree.

classes.name: TreeViewWidget
classes.description: A tree node representing a widget in the inspector's widget tree.

classes.name: WidgetTree
classes.description: A custom TreeView for managing and displaying the widget hierarchy.

classes.name: Inspector
classes.description: Main inspector UI class for highlighting, selecting, and inspecting widgets.

methods.name: create_inspector
methods.description: Creates an Inspector instance and binds it to the application window and widget context.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Schedules creation of the inspector for a given window and context.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Unbinds and removes the inspector from the window and context.
